$comment: Profiles for `pnpm eval <suites> --matrix eval/bench/models.json [--profiles a,b]` and `pnpm bench:e2e --matrix ...`. Each is a set of env overrides on the repo .env; keys (AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, ...) stay in .env. Cloud models go through the Vercel AI Gateway (one key, per-request cost in the report); local ones through compat (Ollama) and openai+OPENAI_BASE_URL (Speaches). Edit freely; this is a starting grid, not a baseline. Two rules learned the hard way: (1) STT must return word timestamps: whisper-1, deepgram, assemblyai, groq whisper and Speaches do; openai/gpt-4o-transcribe does not (segments only), so it is not in the grid. (2) A profile must set TRANSCRIPT_ALIGN_MODEL to match its STT, or it inherits the .env value (a local Speaches model on a self-hosted box) and render becomes the slowest stage: every cut is re-aligned on the CPU.
